Re: Support collectAsMap()

Yes, named list is also an option. I am OK with the named list, but not sure if there is any signicant performance between environment and named list.

In both cases, there is a restriction that Key must be converted to a string. If Key is a complex type in R, it is possible to loss uniquess after string conversion?
